images.caption: Figure 1:Hybrid task-oriented agent for medical image reasoning.To ensure reliable and auditable answers, our agent delegates specific visual reasoning tasks to specialized components. A central VLM-based controller receives a CT slice and a user prompt, extracts the core query, and routes it to an appropriate task-specific pathway. The pathway processes the image and returns a structured, verifiable result. Box colors indicate module type: VLM/language (blue), YOLO perception (green), deterministic logic (orange), and input/output or future extension (gray). Blue arrows mark the evaluated spatial-verification flow; dashed elements mark future extensions. In the evaluated pathway, the binary answer is computed from YOLO detections and deterministic geometry rather than directly predicted by the VLM.
